dossiers.scope: Exact whole pcheey and the three published local sho/sheo pcheey spans in GDT762–763; GDT769 role/identity dispatch over the same admitted target occurrences. Not a free p/cheey component or universal material lexicon.
dossiers.original_assertion: GDT762 preregisters dry source/complement as a genuine rival. Its report retains Feuchtzubereitung mit/aus Trockengut, Form II locally at f10v.1, f105r.24 and f8r.9, while preferring a portable Form-II record field. Source, list/field sequence and post-moist result are explicitly distinct.
dossiers.revision: GDT763 retains the local dry-source rival but states that aus is not an identified relation marker; GDT769 removes dry/powder from the portable default and selects gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld with C0 material/form identity. Paste/salve/mixed form/residue remain candidate identities.
dossiers.actual_revision_argument: GDT769 reports zero eligible F03 dry-frame support, no independent vessel/operation/passage/closing support, and repeated bounded-field geometry. The former powder default based on EVA p=Latin pulvis is separately rejected as invalid evidence. Lack of dry-frame support is not an observed wetness contradiction and does not disprove dry input to a moist preparation.

actually_executed.GDT762: Reported full admitted reader-exact candidate census, eleven authored working dry/moist pairs, distance and exposure contrasts, whole/H1/position-frequency controls. Two sheo cases were known discovery; sho pcheey f8r.9 is the sole new outer replication. The runner computes contacts, but its pcheey revised German gloss and decision string are explicitly assigned constants, not inferred word identity.
actually_executed.GDT763: Reported two of three pcheey X daiin frames versus three of 196 other H1 occurrences; no reader-exact PROCESS/PASS/CLOSE within three slots. This tests textual geometry under working tags, not independently identified preparation/source/result.
actually_executed.GDT769: Reported executed 80 frame,25 role and37 identity evaluations and twelve working readers, with ablation and donor guards. F03 uses eligible radius-two donors carrying authored DRY axes/state polarity. I10 bounded field, I11 powder and I12 residue have fixed distinct signature expressions. These are implemented conditional model comparisons, not a new independent semantic gold test. No runner was executed in this audit. The specific I11 powder/dry-drug and I12 residue hypotheses do not exhaust the earlier generic dry source/complement rival; a field that denotes an input source can still satisfy a record-field description.

inherited_assumptions: GDT762 dry/moist polarity and working meanings come from the fixed state-pair deck; its reported sho/sheo relation is textually real without thereby proving moisture.

GDT769 explicitly maps cheo/cheor to DRY and sheo/sheor to MOIST and inherits other state/role axes. Donor exclusions reduce circular reuse within that working inventory but do not independently prove DRY, amount, Form II or preparation meanings.
The same three physical pcheey loci recur across the reports; later analysis is not three fresh semantic replications.
what_not_refuted: pcheey may denote a dry source or complement of the adjacent preparation under a future independently supported whole/span reading.
A record field may contain a source material: bounded-field and dry-source claims are not logically exclusive.
Paste, salve, mixture, residue and opaque/learned whole remain possible; the cited geometry does not identify a particular material.
Rejecting the p=pulvis mnemonic does not reject the complete word powder hypothesis when supported independently.
dossiers.missing_binding: No independent observation identifies what pcheey denotes, the physical dry/moist property, or whether the span expresses input/source rather than record succession or output. The source relation is not fixed by the reported sequence alone.
dossiers.source_assessment_recommendation: Retain the existing genuine historical rival and its unconfirmed status. Attach the bounded depreference/missing-binding history; do not archive as false extraction or assign a global semantic FAIL. Keep the GDT769 replacement role card distinct from this source-rival proposition.

reopening.criteria_origin: Prospective reviewer proposal, not historical preregistration or rerun permission. Alternative pathways below are not cumulative requirements.
reopening.question: What, if anything, independently binds the pcheey field to a physically dry referent and to an input/source, output/result or separate-item relation? A record-field organization is compatible with a source referent; specify which additional commitments would make concrete alternatives distinguishable.
shared_limits: State which complete whole or exact span and historical/new model version is being tested before consulting fresh target evidence.
For a physical dryness claim, require an independent binding to the relevant referent’s dry property; moisture of an adjacent item alone is neither that binding nor a refutation.
Do not treat input/source, output/result and record organization as necessarily exclusive labels. Freeze observable contrasting commitments only where the proposed hypotheses actually differ.

requirements: Identify genuinely changed evidence or a different declared falsifier addressing the chosen referent/relation question.
Specify the new question’s own adequate provenance, capacity and comparison design before use; this review does not impose the old GDT769 signature or ablation model on every new test.
pathways.scope: A new claim/test may differ from the old signature model; its success does not retroactively validate the historical dry-source assignment.

pathways.applies_only_if: The proposed action reuses GDT769’s authored signature comparison.
requirements: Identify the changed independently supported donor/relation or new eligible occurrence that bears on its missing signature.
Retain the chosen original exactness, provenance, support and strongest-locus exclusion contract; any alteration must be declared as a different test, not silently counted as the old gate passing.
Explain why the tested I11 dry-powder or I12 residue signature actually addresses the particular dry-source commitment under consideration.

not_sufficient: More occurrences scored using the same unvalidated DRY/MOIST and preparation glosses.
The report PASS/validator checks or chosen renderer wording.
Optical p/pulvis resemblance or exporting free substring meanings.

dossiers.would_more_admitted_pages_help: They could add a genuinely independent owned input/result or material-state relation. Additional unbound post-sho/sheo counts alone cannot decide the semantic alternatives.

evidence.quote:
Status: exploratory continuation of the GDT761 lead deck; not a blinded
confirmatory test.

## Fixed targets and rivals

- `ckhy`: specific aqueous/wine medium; oil/oleaginous base; nominal
  preparation/compositum at a beginning stage; open relay/other.
- `pcheey`: specific medium; dry source/complement; post-moist result;
  record/Form-II field; opaque or bound-shell form.
- `ol`: aqueous/wine medium; oil/oleaginous base; general preparation/carrier;
  material/property head; opaque/other.

The eleven state pairs, three candidates, fourteen role hypotheses, exact
whole requirement, two distances, outer/discovery split, and zero component
export are fixed in the three source TSV decks. The two `sheo pcheey` cases are
known discovery observations. Any `sho pcheey` case belongs to the outer
control and is the only possible new replication within this run.

`pcheey` hat nur drei reader-exakte Vorkommen. Alle drei stehen unmittelbar
rechts von einer feuchten Präparationsform:

| Locus | Exakter Ausschnitt | Strukturelle Arbeitslesung | Konkrete C1-Lesung |
|---|---|---|---|
| f10v.1 | `sheo pcheey` | Feuchtzubereitung; [Eintrag:] Trockenform II | Feuchtzubereitung aus Trockengut, Form II |
| f105r.24 | `sheo pcheey` | Feuchtzubereitung; [Eintrag:] Trockenform II | Mazerat/Feuchtzubereitung aus Trockengut, Form II |
| f8r.9 | `sho pcheey` | feuchter Ansatz; [Eintrag:] Trockenform II | Feuchtansatz aus Trockengut, Form II |

Die ersten zwei Stellen waren der GDT761-Fund. Die dritte Stelle mit `sho` ist
die neue Außenreplikation. Das Muster ist nicht bloß deshalb auffällig, weil
`pcheey` selten ist:

- Unter 1,571 quarantäne-sauberen wiederkehrenden Ganzformen ist `pcheey` die
  einzige Form, deren sämtliche Vorkommen direkt nach `sho|sheo` stehen.
- Das bleibt gegenüber 235 Formen mit exakt drei Vorkommen, 91 besonders eng
  gematchten Formen mit drei Vorkommen auf drei Seiten in medialer Position und
  929 Formen mit zwei bis vier Vorkommen einzigartig.
- Im vollständigen H1-Universum gibt es 199 reader-exakte Vorkommen. Die drei
  `pcheey`-Stellen sind die einzigen exakten H1-Treffer nach `sho|sheo`; die
  übrigen 196 haben null.
- Die nahen trockenen H1-Kontrollen `pchey` und `pchy` kommen zusammen siebenmal
  vor und stehen kein einziges Mal nach `sho|sheo`.
- Den elf dry-side Formen stehen 1,158 exakte rechte Nachbargelegenheiten ohne
  `pcheey` gegenüber; die moist-side Formen haben 788 Gelegenheiten und drei

Alle drei Treffer liegen medial auf Absatzanfangszeilen, und jede dieser Zeilen
enthält mehrere H1-Recordformen:

- f10v.1: `paiin | pcheey`;
- f105r.24: `pcheor | paiin | pcheey`;
- f8r.9: `pcheey | pchey`.

Damit ist die sparsamste portable Bedeutung:

> `pcheey` = Trockenzubereitungs-/Form-II-Eintrag; Identität offen.

An genau den drei beobachteten Spans bleibt die konkretere Lesung
„Feuchtzubereitung mit/aus Trockengut, Form II“ als C1-Arbeitstheorie aktiv.
Ein zeitlicher Pfeil wäre zu viel: Die Folge kann eine Quellenrelation, eine
Feldfolge oder eine Listenstruktur ausdrücken. „Trockenmasse/Rückstand nach
Feuchtverarbeitung“ ist schwächer, weil ein Trenn-, Trocknungs-, Ergebnis- oder
Abschlusssignal fehlt.

Wasser, Wein und Öl sind für `pcheey` schlechte Kandidaten. Die Form hat keine
unabhängige Flüssigkeits-, Gefäß- oder Prozesssignatur. Die alte Hauptlesung
„Pulver“ wird entfernt: Sie stammte allein aus der unzulässigen Gleichung EVA
`p` = lateinisch *pulvis*. Logisch könnte die komplette Ganzform später wieder
als Pulver-Kandidat auftauchen, aber nur mit neuer unabhängiger Evidenz.

## The three `pcheey` frames

All three targets are medial on paragraph-start lines and each line contains
at least one additional H1 form. Among the 49 other position-matched H1
occurrences, only fifteen occur on multi-H1 lines. The actual frames are:

1. `f8r.9`: `sho pcheey pchey ofchey dsheey`
   — a moist-preparation head followed by Form II, then a related H1 Form-I
   field, an open field, and an exact moist/material/end field.
2. `f10v.1`: `sheo pcheey qoty daiin cthor`
   — Feuchtzubereitung, Form-II field, working cold/beginning quality, value
   III, then an amount/material whole.
3. `f105r.24`: `sheo pcheey dal daiin dam`
   — Feuchtzubereitung, Form-II field, working material/amount I, value III,
   then measure/value I.

The neutral renderer is therefore a record sequence, for example:

```text
sheo pcheey qoty daiin
→ Feuchtzubereitung — Trockenzubereitung/Form II:
  kalt am Anfang des Grades; Wert III
```

The concrete source rival remains:

```text
sheo pcheey
→ Feuchtzubereitung aus Trockengut, Form II
```

The word “aus” is not encoded by an identified relation marker, so this second
version is deliberately C1 rather than the portable default.

## Why “result” loses

Every `pcheey` has three or five tokens still to its right. None is line-final,
none lies on a paragraph-end line, and none has a reader-exact `PROCESS`,
`PASS`, or `CLOSE` role within three slots on either side. Historical recipe
results are normally accompanied by explicit process or endpoint structure,
such as cooling to a clear oil, straining, or drying. That architecture is
absent here. A residue remains imaginable, but it is no longer a sensible
default.

## Reihenfolge der Entscheidung

1. Zensus und Positionsgeometrie ohne Bedeutung bauen.
2. Alle Bedeutungsgeber durch Targetpanel, GDT754, explizites GDT737-Q80 und
   die gemeinsame ED≤2-Familie sperren.
3. Die 16 festen Rahmensignaturen pro Ziel und locus zählen.
4. Fünf Rollen vergleichen: Nomen/Zubereitung, Vorgang, Produkt, Recordfeld,
   Folgen-/Feldverbinder.
5. Nur innerhalb einer tragfähigen Rolle konkrete Identitätskarten werten.
6. Stärksten stützenden locus entfernen und die notwendige Zwei-Achsen-
   Signatur auf einer zweiten Seite erneut prüfen.
7. Vollständige Zeilen mit konkreten, ersetzbaren Ganzwortdefaults lesen.

## Vorab sichtbare Rivalen

- `ol`: Feldrelation oder Mengenanschluss; allgemeine Zubereitungsbasis;
  Pflanzensaft/Auszug/Dekokt; Öl; Arzneiwasser; Wein; Essig.
- `ckhy`: Mischung/Kompositum; `mischen/vermengen` als rezeptfinaler Vorgang;
  Infusion/Dekokt; Wasser-/Wein-/Essigmedium; Einweichen/Mazerieren.
- `pcheey`: gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld; Paste, Salben- oder
  Mischform II; Pulver/Trockendroge; Rückstand nach Einweichen.
- `ols`: fertige Flüssigzubereitung; Filtrat/Colatur; Saft/Auszug/Dekokt;
  ölige Zubereitung; Abseihen als Vorgang.
- `otar`: Folgen-/Feldverbinder; `dann/danach`; `bis`; Trocknen als Vorgang;
  nominales Zubereitungsfeld; Arzneiwasser/Auszug; Öl; Wein; Essig; Pulver.

## Praktische Auswahlregel

Eine Rolle oder Identität darf als neuer Default ausgegeben werden, wenn ihre
notwendigen Rahmen erfüllt sind, die widersprechende Rollenkarte nicht stärker
ist und die stützende Kombination nach Entfernung des stärksten locus auf
einer weiteren Seite fortbesteht. Bei nicht trennbaren spezifischen Stoffen
wird die engste gemeinsame Klasse ausgegeben, beispielsweise

### `pcheey`: R04 preparation/form-II field, with zero dry evidence

There are only three exact occurrences, but all three immediately follow `sho` or `sheo`, and two form a `pcheey-X-daiin` construction. All three are medial in paragraph-opening lines. This repeated bounded-field geometry supports R04 and the neutral reader phrase `gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld`.

The dry frame F03 has zero support. There is also no independent vessel, operation, passage/straining, or closing signal. A previous powder-like reading inherited from the shape of EVA `p` is therefore excluded from the default. Paste, salve, mixed form, or residue after soaking remain possible identities, but none is selected.

## Claim ceiling and pending status

GDT769 may choose replaceable complete-word roles and context-sensitive reader defaults for these five targets and render twelve already admitted complete lines. It does not confirm a lexeme, plaintext clause, language, cipher, character value, Latin correspondence, productive substring, plant, liquid, disease, cure, vessel, or unseen form. It opens no new manuscript page, image, or transcription, and `f84` and `f84r` remain forbidden.

The runner emitted all 17 declared TSV, Markdown, and JSON artifacts: 640 raw target occurrences, 526 reader-exact target occurrences, 80 frame evaluations, 25 role evaluations, 37 identity evaluations, and twelve complete lines containing 109 tokens, of which 106 are reader-exact. The role scoreboard shows the decisive limitation: `ol` is a three-way R05/R01/R03 tie, while `ols` and `otar` each have a two-way selected-role/R01 tie; only `pcheey` has a unique passing role, and `ckhy` remains open. All zero-credit guards remain intact. The independent validator passes 26,743 checks and byte-replays all 17 builder outputs. These are reproducible but provisional dispatches rather than confirmed translations.

### 1. `f105r.24` — `BOUNDED_QUALITY_VALUE_RECORD`

Working reader: “Trockenposten; Wert II; Kompositum in Endlage; starke Erhitzungs-Endstufe; Recordposten III; Anteil mit Wert IV; Zubereitungsposten II; Feuchtzubereitung; gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld; Rohstoffposten I mit Wert III; Maß I.”

Outcome: `pcheey` stands after the moist preparation and before the completely bounded `dal-daiin` value field. This supports a bounded preparation/form field, while paste, salve, or mixed form remains open.

### 2. `f10v.1` — `PARALLEL_BOUNDED_VALUE_RECORD`

Working reader: “Recordposten III mit Wert III; Feuchtzubereitung; gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld; Kältestufe I mit Wert III; Pflanzendrogenportion; fertiger Kaltansatz; zwei Drachmen.”

Outcome: The parallel `qoty-daiin` boundary after `pcheey` again shows field grammar. `pcheey` remains a bounded preparation/form-II field and expressly not a demonstrated dry form. Final `sain` uses the repaired fused-value default `zwei Drachmen`; the specific unit remains C0.

### 3. `f8r.9` — `PART_OR_FORM_INVENTORY`

Working reader: “Krautdrogenposten; Feuchtansatz; gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld; Trockenform-I-Feld; Blütenzubereitung; vollständig angefeuchtete Drogenportion; Drogenposten III; Fruchtstand.”

Outcome: The third `pcheey` locus confirms a post-moist H1 form cluster without an amount field. It supports a preparation/form field, not dryness; `sholdaiin` remains reader-nonexact.
